Sarasota Performing Arts — January 2027

Updated Wednesday, November 25, 2026, 3:45 AM ET

Filter venues

Summary

Summary

Back to top ↑

January brings 292 performances of 49 productions, at 16 venues in three areas — Sarasota, Venice, and Bradenton. No official Lakewood Ranch listings were found. January 4 and 18 have nothing posted at these venues.

Highlights

Theatre leads the month (136). Florida Studio Theatre keeps The Bully Pulpit onstage all January. Urbanite Theatre reopens January 7 with The Garbologists ($5–$52). Asolo Rep opens August Wilson’s Ma Rainey’s Black Bottom on January 13, after closing Singin’ in the Rain and It’s a Wonderful Life in the first days of the month. Westcoast Black Theatre Troupe wraps A Motown Christmas on January 2–3 and begins A Midsummer Night’s Dream on January 13. Venice Theatre opens Catfish Moon on January 15 and Blood of the Lamb on January 22 ($19–$40).

Broadway (27) includes Kimberly Akimbo at FST through January 10, then Van Wezel runs of Mystic Pizza, The Wiz, and Mamma Mia (January 26–31, $56–$146). The Sarasota Orchestra offers Masterworks: Mozart & Dvořák at the Van Wezel on January 9–10 (from $43) and Pops: Hollywood’s Greatest Hits on January 22–23 (from $45). The Ballet’s Program Four is at the FSU Center January 29–31 ($35–$145), and Cirque des Voix is at The Big Top those same days. No January opera is posted; the Winter Festival begins February 6.

Don’t miss, and the busy days

The last week, January 25–31, is the busiest (83 performances). Saturday the 30th is the peak day (21), with Program Four, Cirque des Voix, and Mamma Mia all in town; Saturday the 23rd is next (18), with the Orchestra’s Pops.

Free and low-cost

The Ringling’s Windjammers Circus Music Concert on January 15 is free for families attending with children under 18. That evening, Van Wezel’s All Abilities Dance Workshop is free. Urbanite student tickets are $5, the Venice Concert Band is $17 on January 25, and The Playboy of the Western World at the Ringling (January 14–15) is $20, or $15 for members and $10 for students.

Still to be listed

Manatee Performing Arts Center has announced The Da Vinci Code (January 14–24) and Come From Away (January 21–31) without daily showtimes, so those runs are not given rows here. The same is true of The Players Centre’s The Producers (January 7–24) and Sarasota Contemporary Dance’s sold-out Dance Makers 2027 (January 14–17). The Jazz Club had not yet posted January concerts. Prices are left blank on 185 performances where official pages did not state them, including the FST, Asolo, and WBTT runs, plus Cirque des Voix.

About this listing

  • Built from official venue and organization sites and the ticket calendars they use, for January 1–31, 2027 only. Checked Sunday, November 22, 2026. Prices and times are left blank when an official source does not post them. Secondary calendars were not used for showtimes.
  • Florida Studio Theatre individual dates and times come from the official ticketing calendars for Kimberly Akimbo, The Bully Pulpit, Sailing: Yacht Rock and Beyond, American Rebels, and Imagination Rocks!. Ticket prices were not cleanly posted on those official marketing or ticketing pages, so the price column is left blank. Official running times are posted for The Bully Pulpit (120 minutes with a 15-minute intermission) and Imagination Rocks! (50 minutes, no intermission). Visit Sarasota lists additional Imagination Rocks! dates that do not appear on the official FST ticketing calendar and are omitted.
  • Van Wezel showtimes follow the official event detail pages. Ticket ranges are listed low to high when the hall posts a high-to-low range. Masterworks: Mozart & Dvořák (January 9–10) and Pops: Hollywood’s Greatest Hits (January 22–23) are at the Van Wezel; tickets are sold by the Sarasota Orchestra, from $43 and from $45 respectively. The official Mamma Mia calendar lists a January 31 matinee and no January 31 evening performance. Official Masterclass: Mamma Mia showings are January 28 and 30 at 11:00 AM only.
  • Asolo Repertory Theatre times for Singin’ in the Rain (Mertz Theatre, through January 2), It’s a Wonderful Life: A Live Radio Play (Jane B. Cook Theatre, through January 3), and August Wilson’s Ma Rainey’s Black Bottom (Mertz Theatre, January 13–February 4; January dates only) come from the official show pages. Single-ticket prices were not posted there.
  • Westcoast Black Theatre Troupe dates for A Motown Christmas (January 2–3) and A Midsummer Night’s Dream (January 13–31; later dates omitted) follow the official production pages. Ticket prices were not posted on those pages.
  • Urbanite Theatre reopens January 7, 2027, with a preview of The Garbologists. Official ticket categories are Standard $52, Under 40 $32, and Student $5. Remaining January dates follow the weekly pattern posted on the official show page (Wednesday 2:00 PM and 7:30 PM; Thursday, Friday, and Saturday 7:30 PM; Sunday 2:00 PM), plus a special Saturday, January 9, 2:00 PM matinee. The official page typographically dates that special matinee “January 9, 2026”; it is included here as a January 9, 2027 performance of this 2027 production.
  • Venice Theatre times for Catfish Moon (Raymond Center, January 15–February 7) and Blood of the Lamb (Pinkerton Theatre, January 22–February 7) follow the official event pages: Tuesday–Saturday 7:30 PM and Sunday 2:00 PM. January dates only are listed. Official prices are $19 youth, $30 college and educators, and $40 adult and seniors.
  • Venice Performing Arts Center listings follow official event pages, including all three posted Mancini and the Movie Masters performances (January 8 at 7:30 PM and January 9 at 3:30 PM and 7:30 PM).
  • Theatre Odyssey’s Ten-Minute Play Festival (January 8–10) is presented at the Jane B. Cook Theatre at the FSU Center for the Performing Arts, 5555 N Tamiami Trail, not at Manatee Performing Arts Center. Showtimes and prices ($32 adult; $16 student, educator, or active military) are taken from the official MPAC 2026–2027 season announcement, which also names the festival venue.
  • Manatee Performing Arts Center has announced The Da Vinci Code (January 14–24; adult tickets $32.50, student/educator/active military $17.50) and Come From Away (January 21–31; starting at $35 / $18.75). Those official announcements do not post individual daily showtimes, so the productions are not given rows here. Listed MPAC January performances with official times are the Manatee Opera Guild British afternoon tea with Sarasota Opera 2027 apprentice artists in concert (January 25, 2:00 PM; $78.50 standard / $103.50 premium patron) and Larger Than Life: The Definitive Boy Band Tribute (January 26, 2:00 PM and 7:00 PM; starting at $37 / $19.75).
  • The Players Centre for Performing Arts has announced The Producers for January 7–24 at 2100 Laurel Street on its official 97th-season page, but that page does not post individual daily showtimes. The production is not given rows here. The Players site was not used as a source for invented times.
  • Sarasota Contemporary Dance has announced Dance Makers 2027 for January 14–17 at the Jane B. Cook Theatre. The official production page describes the run as sold out and does not list individual showtimes, so it is not given rows here.
  • The Sarasota Ballet’s Program Four is January 29–31 at the FSU Center for the Performing Arts (February 1 omitted), $35–$145, from the official production page. It is listed under the FSU Center, not as an Asolo Rep production.
  • Sarasota Opera’s Winter Festival begins February 6, 2027; no January opera performances are posted. A January 30 “A Night of Camellias & Champagne” gala at The Ora is a fundraising event, not a staged opera, and is omitted from the timetable.
  • The Jazz Club of Sarasota official events and calendar pages did not yet list January 2027 concerts (including Jazz at Two) when checked. Dates that appear only on secondary calendars are omitted.
  • Artist Series Concerts official event pages: Schmaltz & Pepper on January 5 at 7:30 PM at The Ora, 578 McIntosh Road ($50 general admission / $70 VIP); Sticks and Strings on January 14 at 11:00 AM at Sarasota Yacht Club, 1100 John Ringling Blvd ($85, includes luncheon); Against All Odds on January 24 at 4:00 PM at First Presbyterian Church, 2050 Oak Street ($50–$70; $10 student tickets at the door); and Piano Grand VI on January 30 at 4:00 PM at Church of the Palms, 3224 Bee Ridge Road ($50–$70; $10 student tickets at the door).
  • The Ringling official event pages: The Playboy of the Western World at the Historic Asolo Theater on January 14 at 6:30 PM and January 15 at 1:00 PM ($20 / $15 members / $10 students); and the Windjammers Circus Music Concert on January 15 at 11:00 AM (about 45 minutes). Official wording is that the Windjammers concert is free for families attending with children under 18, with no registration required; a general-admission price for others is not clearly posted.
  • The Circus Arts Conservatory’s Cirque des Voix: Fantastical Journeys, a collaboration with Key Chorale and The Venice Symphony, is January 29–31 at The Big Top at the UTC Mall (January 29 at 7:00 PM, January 30 at 2:00 PM and 7:00 PM, January 31 at 2:00 PM). A ticket price is not posted on the official performance page. No January Sailor Circus arena show is posted; the next Sailor Circus production is in the spring.
  • The Manatee Community Concert Band’s Horizons: A Musical Journey is Saturday, January 30, from 3:00 to 5:00 PM at SCF Neel Performing Arts Center (Building 11 East), 5840 26th Street West, Bradenton. A ticket price is not posted on the official SCF event page.
  • No official January 2027 concert listings were found for Via Nova Chorale, The Venice Chorale, the Sarasota Choral Society, New College / Mildred Sainer Pavilion, the Sarasota Music Festival or Sarasota Music Conservatory, or additional Sarasota Orchestra Holley Hall chamber concerts beyond the Van Wezel Masterworks and Pops already listed. A “Barbershop Quartet and More” program attributed to the Chorus of the Keys at Selby Library on January 20 appeared only on a library/secondary listing and is not on chorusofthekeys.org, so it is omitted.
  • Days in January with nothing posted at these venues are omitted from the timetable.
